msg: There are different coloured gnomes (pay attention to the hats) and each coloured gnome has either a red or yellow basket. Yellow basket: orange, blue, green, yellow gnomes. Red basket: brown, red, pink, purple gnomes. To be the most successful, I found that go for one basket at a time. For example, keep clicking yellow basket gnomes. This is until the mushroom yield begins to dwindle. When this happens (i.e. less that 5) switch to red basket gnomes. Keep going in this sequence. This isn't a perfect rule, but helps.
